## What it does

<!-- BEGIN AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->
Formatting, tone, and language rules for engagement reports
<!-- END AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->

## When to use it

This instruction applies while drafting or reviewing engagement reports. It
keeps status language concise, distinguishes completed and planned work, and
calibrates detail and tone for the configured internal or external audience.

Use the selected report template for section structure; this instruction owns
the language and presentation within that structure.

## Example usage

Instead of writing `The team made great progress on deployment`, the report
states the evidenced result and status, such as `The team completed staging
deployment and is validating production prerequisites`.
